Add packed Cellar state, real-object staging, route sensing, hazard screening, recoverable quarantine, intrusion evidence, and recap

preserved_canonical_state: the real rug, trap door, staircase, first-descent slam and bar, Cellar exits, and upward route remain canonical
the Cellar underside is an observational surface only and creates no duplicate door, lock, or route
real lights, rope, tools, bottle, water, containers, actors, ritual objects, score, and puzzle state remain authoritative
staging, hooks, and quarantine use the ordinary canonical object tree and never create loadout tokens
hazard screening reports existing darkness, flame, water, wetness, fragility, supernatural state, and instability without cancelling consequences
intrusion hooks leave bounded physical evidence but do not simulate broad creature, fire, smoke, water, or supernatural propagation
native save and restore preserve the packed threshold table and real fixture contents without a repair pass
excluded_scope: unlimited storage, remote retrieval, or teleportation
broad smoke, water, fire, creature, or supernatural propagation
automatic puzzle preparation, safe passage, or route unlocking
duplicated lights, tools, hazards, actors, or puzzle objects
new score or automatic puzzle completion
sub-beads or a parallel planning hierarchy
